Plan and log training, build combinations, analyse technique videos, review matches, track runs with GPS and follow your recovery — all in one place.

TKD PRO is for one athlete: you. Your data stays on this phone. There are no public profiles, followers or location sharing. AI features are off until you choose what to share, and only with your own backend.
Just the essentials. You can change everything later in Settings.
Optional. Used only to apply age-appropriate privacy defaults.
No screen lock or biometrics are set up on this device, so the app lock cannot be used. Set up a screen lock in your device settings to protect your data.
Take 30 seconds to log your sleep, energy and soreness.
Choose which cards appear on Home and in which order.
Nothing logged or planned for today.
No check-in yet today. Tap to log how you feel.
No completed sessions this week yet.
No AI report yet. Generate one from the AI Coach when you are ready.
No activity in the last two weeks.
Log your first training session to start building your history.
1 = very easy, 10 = maximal effort. Rate the whole session.
Record a technique block with repetitions, sides and timing.
The session and its technique records will be permanently deleted.
Session load = duration × RPE. A simple subjective training-load estimate, not a physiological measurement.
Try another search or add a custom technique.
Totals from all recorded technique blocks.
Record this technique inside a training session to build its history.
Build sequences like Bandal Chagi → Dollyo Chagi → Dwi Chagi and track how often you practise them.
Record a practice block after drilling this combination.
The combination and its practice history will be permanently deleted.
All match data is entered manually by you. Nothing here is detected automatically.
Record matches and rounds to review tactics, strengths and progress over time.
Successful attacks cannot exceed attack attempts.
No earlier matches to compare with.
Previous %1$d matches: average attack success %2$s, average attack attempts %3$s (manual data).
The match, its rounds and key moments will be permanently deleted.
Competition scoring rules change. Enter point values from the current official rules yourself; TKD PRO never hardcodes them.
No presets. Add values such as “Trunk kick” with the points used in your competitions.
Recording continues with the screen off. Your route stays private on this device.
Waiting for better GPS accuracy. You can start now; inaccurate points are filtered out.
GPS is used only while you record a run, to measure distance, pace and route. Location is never shared.
Location permission was denied. Running cannot be recorded without it.
The recorded route and data will be deleted.
The run will be saved and its summary calculated from the recorded GPS points.
Start your first GPS run to see distance, pace, splits and records.
Analytics appear after your first completed run.
Distance comes from filtered GPS points; phone GPS normally has a few metres of error.
Tap to add notes or heart-rate data
Optional. Enter values from a compatible heart-rate device; they are never estimated.
The run, route and splits will be permanently deleted.
Pace depends on run type, terrain and conditions; compare runs of the same type.
Records are calculated only from completed, saved runs.
Shown side by side for context only. Running pace does not directly measure Taekwondo fighting endurance.
Tap as soon as the screen turns red.
Tap as soon as you hear the beep. Turn the volume up.
Each trial randomly uses a colour change or a beep.
Results include your phone’s touch, display and audio latency, so they are only comparable on the same device. Taps under 100 ms (anticipation) and over 1000 ms (lapse) are excluded.
%1$s on phone screen/speaker. Random 1.5–4 s foreperiod. Valid range %2$d–%3$d ms. Values include device touch/display/audio latency.
Choose a test above. Sit comfortably and use the same hand each time.
This reaction test and its attempts will be permanently deleted.
These tests track your own progress over time. They are not medical or diagnostic assessments.
Stand on one leg with hands on hips. Start the timer when your foot leaves the floor; stop it when you touch down or move your standing foot (max 120 s).
As above, with eyes closed. Have something stable within reach for safety.
Tap the L and R buttons alternately as fast as you can for 10 seconds. Only correct alternations count.
Use a standard sit-and-reach box or ruler and record your best of three reaches in cm.
Measure the distance from the floor to your hips in cm. Lower is better. Warm up first and never force the stretch.
Jump from a standing two-foot take-off and measure from the line to the back of the nearest heel with a tape measure.
Use a jump mat, a validated app or the wall-mark (chalk) method, and record the method used.
Use a marked hexagon (60 cm sides) and record the time for three full rotations.
Jump results are only saved with a stated method (e.g. tape measure, jump mat).
Resting heart rate (optional, from a device)
High soreness noted. Do not train through pain; reduce intensity, rest, and consult a qualified professional if pain persists.
Film from the side, whole body in frame, good light, phone stable, 2–30 seconds, one person in view.
Runs on this phone with MediaPipe Pose. The video never leaves the device.
Runs on your own backend (MediaPipe + OpenCV). The video is uploaded to your server.
Smartphone video cannot measure kick force, impact speed, scoring validity or injury risk. Results are 2D estimates of visible movement.
Select two analyses to compare them.
Analyse a technique video to see pose overlay, joint angles and repetition consistency.
Video is longer than 30 seconds. Trim it to the repetitions you want analysed.
Server analysis is selected but no backend is configured. Switch to on-device analysis in Settings or configure your backend.
The analysis server could not process the video. Check the connection in Settings.
The video could not be analysed. Try another recording.
Skeleton overlay shows estimated landmarks for the nearest analysed frame.
This analysis result cannot be read.
Pose detected in %1$s of frames · key landmark visibility %2$s
No metrics were produced. Record again from the side with your whole body visible, in good light, without other people in the frame.
No kicking repetitions were detected. Check the selected side and that the kicking leg is visible.
Only one repetition detected; consistency cannot be assessed.
Mean, range and coefficient of variation (CV) across repetitions. Lower CV = more consistent. Angles are 2D projections and depend on camera position.
Right ankle height (torso lengths, relative to hip)
Left ankle height (torso lengths, relative to hip)
Ask the AI to explain these metrics in plain language. Only the numeric summary is sent, never the video.
The analysis, its pose data and the source video will be permanently deleted.
These analyses are of different techniques; comparisons may not be meaningful.
Both analyses must have passed the quality check to be compared.
The two analyses share no comparable metrics (e.g. different sides).
Differences of a few degrees can come from camera position alone. Film from the same angle and distance for fair comparisons.
Too few frames could be analysed
Low frame rate; fast kicks may be missed
The body was not detected in many frames
Hips, knees or ankles are often hidden or unclear
Parts of the body leave the frame

A local reminder if you have not checked in yet. Nothing is sent off the device.
Pause the timer when you stop moving for 10 seconds.
Ignore points less accurate than %1$d m
Lower values give cleaner routes but may drop more points under trees or between buildings.
Routes are private and stored only on this device (and your own backend if sync is on). There is no live location sharing.
Require biometrics or your screen lock to open TKD PRO.
Confirm to change the app lock
No public profile, no registration, no social features. Data is excluded from cloud backups.
Your profile indicates you are under 18. AI features and backend sync stay off unless enabled together with a parent or guardian, in line with applicable consent rules.
AI requests go only to your own backend, which calls the AI provider. No API keys are stored in the app.
Name, club, coach, photos, videos and GPS routes are never sent to the AI.
Optional. Your own TKD PRO backend (FastAPI) for AI, server analysis and backup sync. See the setup guide in the project docs.
Owner access token (saved · enter to replace)
Two-way: changes are queued locally, sent when online, and changes from the computer are applied here. Pending: %1$d

Use TKD PRO on your computer and this phone with the same data. Start TKD PRO on the computer, open Settings → Connect a device there, then enter the address and the 6-digit code shown. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi (or Tailscale).
Paired. Your data is being synced with the computer.
Use https://, or http:// only with a home-network address (e.g. 192.168.x.x).
Includes all records and GPS routes. Videos stay on the device and are listed by file name.
This permanently deletes every record, video, analysis, route, report and setting on this device. Export first if you want a copy.
